messages:
micaela: Heads-up — sample-app README embeddings snippet is out of date. Trying the quickstart and it crashes.

micaela: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")

resp = client.embeddings.create(model_name="embed-1", input="hello")
print(resp.embeddings[0].vector)
```

micaela: Error: AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'embeddings'

sam: Yep saw this earlier. SDK changed last release — new call is create_embeddings and args are slightly different.

sam: Corrected snippet:

sam: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

resp = client.create_embeddings(model="embed-1", inputs=["hello"])
print(resp["data"][0]["embedding"])
```

anna: Can we update the README in sample-app and the quickstart template? Also need to change param name in the Go example in /examples/embedding/main.go — it uses "model_name" too.

micaela: I'll open a PR with the README fix + a small note in CHANGELOG. Branch: docs/embeddings-readme-fix

micaela: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/321

doc-bot: Created issue #842 to track README + example parity.

deploy-bot: FYI CI also failed on the sample-app because the Dockerfile pins redwood-runtime:1.2.0 — runtime v1.3.0 changed env var names. Linking in PR.

sam: Thanks — I'll add a compatibility note and a short migration snippet.

micaela: @anna @sam tagging for review. Will merge once CI green. :crossed_fingers:
